svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Disc 120 mm across, 6 mm thick, with a hub 20 mm across, 9 mm long,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on its chain-side face. Bore 12.4 mm with a flat 4.6 mm from centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Maize plate: 4 cells in the rim, 14.3 mm long, 8.7 mm deep, through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the thickness. Other crops: cells from the rule in the model (seed

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: length x 1.15 + 0.5, width x 1.05 + 0.3; thickness at least 6).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat, hub up, no supports: about 44 g and 1.5 h in PETG.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the crop and cell count on the face (raised text).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides onto the shaft's D-flat until the hub meets the collar; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hub runs in the housing's 22 mm hole; the knob holds it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a kernel sits in each cell level with the rim, not proud of it.
